programs.title: Wild Birds of Australia
programs.desc: Australia’s birds of prey are some of the region's fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australia’s aerial hunters.

programs.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programs.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher’s pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

director: Hayley Smith, Caroline Hawkins, Clare Birks:Producers

programs.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programs.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

director: Hayley Smith, Caroline Hawkins, Clare Birks:Producers

programs.title: Wildlife ER
programs.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree’s clutch of python eggs hatch.

director: Annie Gray: Series Producer, Justine Clark: Narrator

programs.title: 13 Hours to Survive
programs.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

director: Mark Woordward: Series Producer/Director, Emma Ross: Executive Producer

programs.title: 13 Hours to Survive
programs.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

director: Mark Woordward: Series Producer/Director, Emma Ross: Executive Producer
